title: Definition of gardening in horticulture
competency: Describe what horticulture and gardening are.

keywords.def: The art or science of growing flowers, fruits, vegetables and shrubs, especially in gardens or orchards.
The practice of growing and cultivating plants, as part of horticulture.
Growing crops and also farming animals.

en.text: Horticulture is the art or science of growing flowers, fruits, vegetables and shrubs. It is a part of agriculture that deals with plants only. Gardening is growing and caring for plants on a plot of ground, for food, beauty, dyes, medicine or cosmetics.

screens.title: Brainstorming
screens.ask: What does gardening mean to you?
screens.after: Gardening is growing and caring for plants: flowers, herbs or vegetables. Read on.

screens.title: Unit 3: Self-employment opportunities
paras: This unit is about work you can do for yourself.
It covers gardening, dairy farming, animal fattening, poultry and bee keeping.

screens.title: 3.1.1 Definition of gardening in horticulture
paras: Horticulture is the art or science of growing flowers, fruits, vegetables and shrubs.
It is done especially in gardens or orchards.
Horticulture is a subdivision of agriculture.
Agriculture covers crops and animal farming. Horticulture covers plants only.

screens.title: What gardening is
paras: As part of horticulture, gardening is the practice of growing and cultivating plants.
It involves laying out and caring for a plot of ground.
Plants are grown for their flowers, leaves or appearance.
They are also grown for food, for dyes, and for medicine or cosmetics.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The art or science of growing flowers, fruits, vegetables and shrubs.
Growing and cultivating plants, as part of horticulture.
Growing crops and also farming animals.

screens.text: How is horticulture different from agriculture?
screens.why: Agriculture covers crops and animals. Horticulture is the part that deals with growing plants.

screens.text: Horticulture is a subdivision of agriculture.
screens.why: The book says horticulture is a subdivision of agriculture.
screens.clue: Is it a part of something bigger?

opts: Growing plants for food, medicine or cosmetics
screens.why: Gardening grows plants for flowers, leaves, appearance, food, dyes, medicine and cosmetics.

screens.ask: Hiwot grows tena adam in her garden to treat colds. She is growing a ___ plant.
screens.why: Plants grown to treat illness are medicinal plants.
screens.clue: What is the plant used for?

screens.text: Abebe keeps cows and grows maize. Chala grows tomatoes, roses and lemons only. Who works in horticulture only?
screens.why: Horticulture is about plants only: fruits, vegetables, flowers. Abebe also keeps animals, which is wider agriculture.
